reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in a thread on her #central-team message. The 2026 renewal at Marrow Agrisupply is **382 seats**: Tobias posted that in #central-team on Oct 14, and nothing in the channel since then changes it.

She's a member of #central-team, so she could already see Tobias's post. A seat count is an account fact, not a money term, so it's fine to share with the team.

I didn't get anything from gbrain. It refused the search because its access token isn't tied to any member yet, so I read #central-team directly. To fix it, someone who runs the brain server needs to run `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <MEMBER>` on that host.
